equip.judge: Is it handed over physically, without registration?
equip.s1: Check that the equipment runs in person — photos alone are not enough
equip.s2: Check whether any lease or installment balance remains
equip.s3: Put removal and relocation terms and costs in the contract

realty.judge: Is there a property registration record?
realty.s1: Check the owner, mortgages and seizures on the property register
realty.s2: Check for double contracts on key money
realty.s3: Check whether the contract needs the landlord's consent
realty.s4: For large amounts, have a contract and tax invoice in place first — the platform does not handle payments
